title: Capsule Chrome Contract Locked Demo
description: A dogfood capsule for testing a locked, host-friendly story presentation without losing standalone Capsule behavior.

sections.title: One content layer first
sections.body: The capsule-root reader view remains the primary meaning. Alternate views are declared presentations derived from that same substance.

sections.title: Chrome has one owner
sections.body: When a reel or slide deck declares capsule-owned chrome, a host should recede and show only a minimal escape or back affordance.

sections.title: Story can lock the viewport
sections.body: A declared locked story disables scroll, pinch, and drag-dismiss gestures inside the presentation so taps, swipes, and playback controls remain predictable.

sections.title: Standalone still works
sections.body: Opening the capsule in a normal browser should show the same controls and presentation behavior because the artifact carries its own runtime.

sections.title: Vault can enhance
sections.body: HTML Vault may add custody views, validation, search, tags, lineage, and safe preview, but those app views are not capsule presentations.

sections.title: Dogfood outcome
sections.body: A successful test has no double chrome, a useful JS-off reader layer, declared entries that resolve, and no accidental zoom or vertical wobble.

assets.alt: Four presentation surfaces derived from one Capsule data model.

cards.title: Locked Chrome Contract
cards.body: One capsule can stand alone and still let Vault host it without scroll wobble.

cards.title: One owner
cards.body: If the capsule owns controls, the host should not wrap it with a second control system.

cards.title: Lock the reel
cards.body: Story mode is a fixed viewport. Swipe advances, tap navigates, and the page itself does not drift.

cards.title: Browser ready
cards.body: The same reel and slides should work when opened directly from the file system.

cards.title: Vault enhances
cards.body: Custody, validation, search, tags, and lineage are host features around the artifact.

cards.title: No wobble
cards.body: That is the acceptance test for the locked presentation contract.
